body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Calm, disciplined technician from Singapore; exact consequences and no extra words. Voice direction: Older, slightly husky male voice with a Singaporean English accent. Deliberate, economical phrasing and dry, unshakeable confidence; calm and exact. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Loose piece. The defender moved, so nothing protects it. The opponent captures next move. Before moving a defender, confirm what it guards.
